nodes.short_description: Reshape your room, rescue hilarious Cosmic Critters, and pretend you totally understand what's going on in HEALER! The fast, chaotic, and questionably therapeutic mixed reality endless roguelite. Every run reshapes your world and your spot on the global leaderboard.

Healer is a mixed reality rogue-lite, where you wield creation itself. Collect Cosmic Critters, solve orb-popping puzzles, and overcome an interdimensional virus as you shape a unique universe with every run.
